question: EasyUsenet's two plans (1 Month Unlimited at 5.98 EUR, 1 Year Unlimited at 3.98 EUR a month) were drafted as two records with different tiers and a different identity kind (email vs card). Should the yearly plan be its own record, and should identity_cost.kind be email when payment may be by SEPA or crypto?
why: Both plans need e-mail, country and a payment method; the corpus labels every paid-only usenet record with a payment requirement as card, so card is kept, but the yearly tier has no record of its own.
